answer: Split the economy into small reward clusters, like a nebula broken into stars: each cluster's emission pool is fixed per epoch, so flooding it with fake identities only dilutes the attacker's own share — the marginal gain of each extra identity nears zero while registration still costs gas and time. Honest agents stay in the ivory tower of their long-lived cluster, while a new identity starts in the lotus pond: quarantined, low limits, and must complete real verified work before touching the shared pool. Sybil scale buys nothing when the pie is fixed and newcomers pay in work first.
